must_read.title: Ferroptosis and Lipid Metabolic Dysregulation Are Associated With Periodontitis and Peri-Implantitis Complicated by Type 2 Diabetes: A Cross-Sectional Study
must_read.title_zh: 铁死亡与脂质代谢失调与糖尿病合并牙周炎及种植体周炎的关联：一项横断面研究
must_read.domain: 牙周炎通过哪些可验证的通…
must_read.cluster: 牙周炎-糖尿病代谢交互
must_read.one_line: 非靶向代谢组学发现T2DM合并牙周炎/种植体周围炎存在特征性脂质代谢重编程，伴线粒体超微结构改变。
must_read.so_what: 直接回应q2（牙周-糖尿病通路）和q4（材料-免疫对话）的机制层面；提出铁死亡作为可验证干预靶点。
must_read.caution: 横断面设计无法确立因果；n=30仍需验证；C8需独立队列确认。
must_read.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Although the clinical associations between T2DM and periodontal or peri-implant diseases have garnered widespread attention, metabolomic studies decoding the specific local metabolic alterations within these comorbid conditions remain scarce. This study aimed to apply untargeted metabolomics to elucidate the potential metabolic signatures of T2DM in periodontitis and peri-implantitis. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Thirty patients were enrolled in this non-target metabolomics study. Gingival crevicular fluid (GCF) and peri-implant crevicular fluid (PICF) samples were collected and analyzed. It further investigates the commonalities and heterogeneity in metabolic profiles between T2DM with periodontitis (T2DM-P) and T2DM with peri-implantitis (T2DM-PI). Furthermore, mitochondrial ultrastructure was evaluated via transmission electron microscopy (TEM), and select differential metabolites were cross-validated utilizing immunofluorescence (IF) and immunohistochemistry (IHC). RESULTS: Our data indicate that T2DM is associated with lipid metabolism dysregulation. In the T2DM-P group, C8 and C10 showed exploratory signals of altered acylcarnitine metabolism. Moreover, γ-GGC and 13-HPOT in the T2DM-PI group and L-cystine in the T2DM-P group were identified as potential candidate metabolites. However, these findings did not remain statistically significant after FDR correction and should be interpreted cautiously. Integrating these metabolomic findings with our experimental findings from TEM, IF, and IHC suggests that cellular ferroptosis emerges as a potential common pathway linked to T2DM-related oral tissue destruction. CONCLUSION: This study not only reveals the potential metabolic signatures of T2DM-P and T2DM-PI but also highlights the underlying involvement of ferroptosis. Nonetheless, these exploratory findings require rigorous empirical validation for future clinical interventions.

deep.title_zh: 铁死亡与脂质代谢失调与糖尿病合并牙周炎及种植体周炎的关联：一项横断面研究
deep.one_sentence: T2DM合并牙周/种植体周炎患者GCF/PICF中显示脂质代谢异常（酰基肉碱、HPOT等），铁死亡可能为共同潜在通路，但经FDR校正后无代谢物达统计显著，结论需谨慎解读。
deep.question: T2DM如何通过局部代谢重编程加剧牙周炎和种植体周炎的骨组织破坏？两种疾病的代谢谱是否存在共性或异质性？
deep.design: 单组横断面研究，含T2DM合并牙周炎（T2DM-P）、T2DM合并种植体周炎（T2DM-PI）及健康对照（摘要未明确说明对照组名称与数量），各组采集龈沟液（GCF）和种植体周分泌液（PICF）进行非靶向代谢组学分析；辅以透射电镜（TEM）观察线粒体超微结构，选择差异代谢物行免疫荧光（IF）和免疫组化（IHC）验证。摘要未说明盲法、随机化及随访。
deep.sample_desc: 共30例患者，来自口腔临床，具体分组人数及各组来源（如是否匹配糖尿病控制指标）摘要未说明

findings.evidence: GCF/PICF非靶向代谢组学提示酰基肉碱代谢通路异常信号

findings.claim: T2DM-P组存在酰基肉碱C8、C10的改变趋势
findings.evidence: 探索性信号（exploratory signals），经FDR校正后不再显著
同上，经FDR校正后均不显著，作者明确建议谨慎解读

findings.claim: 铁死亡可能是T2DM相关口腔组织破坏的共同潜在通路
findings.evidence: 整合代谢组学结果与TEM（线粒体超微结构改变）、IF和IHC结果共同推断

deep.effect: 未报告效应量或置信区间（仅为探索性代谢标志物筛选）
deep.relation: 与q2（牙周炎影响全身疾病通路）最相关，提供了一条'代谢-铁死亡'的潜在因果链路假说；同时与q4（生物材料如何编程宿主免疫）部分交叉，因铁死亡本身是细胞死亡方式，可触发炎症级联。不直接回答q1/q3/q5。
deep.why: 将'T2DM加重牙周/种植体周病'这一已知临床现象推进到机制层面——不是笼统地说'高糖导致炎症'，而是指向脂质过氧化（13-HPOT）和谷胱甘肽代谢（L-cystine、γ-GGC）失衡驱动的 ferroptosis。这对理解为什么T2DM患者的种植体周炎更顽固、骨丧失更快提供了新的分子解释框架。但作者自己也承认证据较弱，适合做 hypothesis-generating 而非 definiti…
limitations: 样本量仅30例，且分组人数未披露，统计效力严重不足，FDR校正后无一代谢物显著；
横断面设计无法推断因果方向（是T2DM驱动了代谢改变还是牙周炎本身导致的继发现象？）；TEM/IF/IHC为辅助验证，缺乏特异性 ferroptosis 抑制剂或基因敲除实验的直接功能证据；
未报告糖尿病控制指标（HbA1c、空腹血糖）与代谢物/铁死亡标志物的剂量-反应关系，难以区分'T2DM状态'与'高血糖程度'各自贡献。
deep.transferable: ① GCF/PICF非靶向代谢组学+TEM联合策略可用于评估任何宿主-微生物互作场景下的细胞死亡模式；② 13-HPOT作为脂质过氧化标志物可直接用于后续验证实验（ELISA或LC-MS/MS靶向定量）；③ 该文的分组逻辑（同一T2DM人群对比牙周 vs 种植体周）值得借鉴，可在自己的课题中复现此比较设计。
followups: 在T2DM-P和T2DM-PI患者配对样本中，GPX4、ACSL4、FPN1等ferroptosis核心蛋白的表达是否在牙周袋/种植体周袋黏膜中显著上调？是否有文献已报道？
13-HPOT或C8/C10酰基肉碱在牙周炎或种植体周炎患者GCF中的水平，与非糖尿病患者相比有无独立预测价值？是否有已发表的靶向代谢组学研究？
铁死亡抑制剂（如Fer-1）或脂质过氧化阻断剂能否在体外或动物模型中缓解T2DM背景下牙周致病菌诱导的成骨抑制？最新系统评价或RCT是否涉及此干预点？

glossary.cn: 13-过氧化氢八碳三烯酸（脂质过氧化产物）
γ-谷氨酰转移酶（谷胱甘肽代谢相关酶）
L-胱氨酸（谷胱甘肽合成前体）

problems: 设计字段写入了摘要中不存在的'健康对照'组，摘要仅提及30名患者及T2DM-P/T2DM-PI两组，属虚构分组
样本描述'来自口腔临床'及'是否匹配糖尿病控制指标'为摘要外推断，虽已标注但设计字段中的对照表述构成事实性添加
limitations中'缺乏特异性ferroptosis抑制剂或基因敲除实验'等属于合理推断但部分表述（如HbA1c未报告）超出摘要可验证范围

must_reads.title: Expert consensus on periodontal management for medically compromised patients
must_reads.title_zh: 全身疾病患者牙周管理的专家共识
must_reads.one_line: IJO出版专家共识，整合牙周炎与多系统共病的证据，提出动态管理框架。
must_reads.so_what: 系统性梳理q2的证据链，可快速定位已有共识缺口；但非原始机制研究。
must_reads.caution: 专家共识≠高级别证据；部分推荐缺乏高质量RCT支撑。
must_reads.abstract: Periodontitis is a highly prevalent oral disease that extends beyond local inflammation and tissue destruction to exert a profound influence on systemic health. With the growing burden of multimorbidity, where multiple systemic disorders frequently co-exist, periodontal management has become increasingly complex, yet clear and integrated guidance for this specific patient population remains limited. This manuscript synthesizes current evidence on the bidirectional relationship between periodontitis and systemic conditions, proposes recommendations for dynamic periodontal management, and updates relevant therapeutic strategies. This expert consensus is designed to ensure both the safety and efficacy of periodontal treatment, reduce the risk of complications, and ultimately promote oral and general well-being.

deep.title_zh: 全身疾病患者牙周管理的专家共识
deep.one_sentence: 系统性综述了牙周炎与全身疾病的交互证据，提出了动态管理路径，为临床决策提供框架而非新机制发现。
deep.question: 对于合并多种全身疾病的患者，牙周治疗如何在安全前提下获得可预测的疗效？双向关系的具体干预节点在哪里？
deep.design: 专家共识（多作者协作，基于现有文献的系统性证据整合），无对照组、无随机分组。摘要未说明随访期限。
deep.sample_desc: 非原始研究，无样本；证据来源为已发表的临床研究及基础研究的综合整合，具体纳入文献数量和类型摘要未说明。

findings.claim: 牙周炎与多种全身系统性疾病存在双向关联，且共病负担加重使牙周管理复杂化。
findings.evidence: 共识基于现有证据的综合表述，未提供定量数据或效应量。

findings.claim: 提出了适用于全身疾病患者的动态牙周管理推荐意见和更新的诊疗策略。
findings.evidence: 结论性陈述，具体的推荐条目和策略分类在全文中呈现，摘要未列出细节。

findings.claim: 共识目标为降低并发症风险、保障治疗效果，促进口腔与全身健康。
findings.evidence: 定性目标描述，无量化终点指标报告。

deep.effect: 未报告（共识文件非循证Meta分析，不提供合并效应量）。
deep.relation: 与q2最直接相关——讨论牙周炎通过哪些通路影响糖尿病、心血管疾病等全身疾病；与q4部分相关——涉及生物材料/治疗手段在特殊人群中如何影响宿主反应。不是q1（种植体周微环境机制）、q3（微生物组因果推断）或q5（肿瘤免疫）的核心直接回答。
deep.why: 它回答了临床研究生最实际的困惑：面对合并糖尿病的牙周炎患者，该不该做SRP？何时需抗生素覆盖？围手术期血糖目标值是多少？——这些问题在论文正文中会被具体条目化，对临床决策有立即可用的指导价值，而不仅是机制认知更新。
limitations: 非原始研究，本质是专家经验性综合，证据等级上限受限于所纳入研究的异质性。
摘要未披露纳入文献的数量、检索策略和时间范围，无法评估其证据基础的完整度。
作为共识文件，关键推荐意见的强度评级（如GRADE分级）未在摘要体现，读者难以判断每条建议的证据确定性。
deep.transferable: 可借鉴的是其'共病分层管理'的逻辑框架——将不同全身状况（糖尿病控制水平、心血管风险评估、用药情况）映射到牙周治疗的不同安全层级，这一思路可直接迁移至你的课题设计：例如在设计种植体周围软组织愈合实验时，对照组的'正常' vs '共病'状态可借鉴此种分层逻辑来设定动物模型分组。

scan.title: Tooth Survival and Periapical Healing After Nonsurgical Root Canal Treatment: A Systematic Review and Paired Meta-analysis of Reporting Discordance
scan.title_zh: NSRCT后牙齿存留与根尖愈合的报告差异Meta分析
scan.one_line: 配对Meta分析量化了牙齿存留率与严格根尖愈合率的系统性差异，揭示报告不一致问题。
scan.so_what: 对q1无直接影响；但研究设计可作为未来根尖手术结局评估方法的参考。
scan.caution: 相关性假设0.5为主观设定，敏感性分析范围有限。
scan.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Tooth survival and strict periapical healing are commonly presented as parallel outcomes, although differences in endpoint definitions, denominators, and follow-up can make the estimates non-equivalent. This review quantified the within-study difference and examined its value as a marker of reporting discordance. METHODS: PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science were searched from inception through October 6, 2026; Scopus was searched on November 14, 2026, and supplementary searching continued through November 15, 2026. Longitudinal studies reporting tooth survival or functional retention and periapical healing at 1 year or longer after primary or secondary nonsurgical root canal treatment were eligible. The effect was the study-level absolute difference between marginal survival and strict-healing proportions. Restricted maximum likelihood random-effects models used modified Knapp-Hartung inference. Because within-study covariance was unreported, a correlation of 0.50 was prespecified as a pragmatic midpoint; correlations of 0 and 0.80 were examined as boundary sensitivity analyses. RESULTS: The updated review included 42 reports representing 40 unique cohorts; 31 cohorts contributed to the primary paired analysis, representing 7,499 teeth in survival risk sets and 6,783 in healing risk sets. Survival exceeded healing in 27 of 31 cohorts. The pooled difference was 8.8 percentage points (95% CI, 5.2-12.5; I2=94.2%), and the 95% prediction interval crossed zero (-10.7 to 28.4 percentage points). Estimates remained similar across correlation assumptions, but treatment-stratified and center-stratified summaries were heterogeneous and imprecise. Certainty was very low. CONCLUSIONS: The average difference between reported survival and strict healing should not be interpreted as a universal biological constant. It primarily exposes non-equivalent outcome definitions, risk sets, and follow-up. Future endodontic outcome studies should report both endpoints at matched time points and denominators and provide tooth-level joint outcome tables.

scan.title: Rethinking Oncologic Trismus: Evidence for an Undermeasured Soft Tissue Phenotype
scan.title_zh: 重新审视肿瘤性张口受限：未被充分量化的软组织结构型表型
scan.one_line: 832例头颈癌幸存者分析显示面部HNL/F分级与MIO降低显著相关，纤维化是独立预测因子。
scan.so_what: 为q5（鳞癌免疫微环境）提供临床转化参照——软组织结构型表型量化可作为治疗抵抗的生物标志物框架。
scan.caution: 回顾性单中心设计，因果推断有限；纤维化作为因还是果仍需组织学验证。
scan.abstract: BACKGROUND: Soft tissue impairment spanning the lymphedema-fibrosis continuum and trismus are highly prevalent head and neck cancer toxicities. While fibrosis is often implicated in trismus, no prior study has directly examined the association between clinician-graded head and neck lymphedema and fibrosis (HNL/F) and maximal interincisal opening (MIO). METHODS: HNL/F classifications and MIO were evaluated in 832 cancer survivors at a specialized Trismus Clinic (2020-2025). Spearman's correlation, ANOVA, univariate, and multivariate linear regression examined HNL/F-MIO relationships overall and by region (face, neck, and intraoral). RESULTS: In unadjusted and adjusted analyses, all clinician-graded HNL/F classifications in the face were significantly associated with reduced MIO. In all regions, fibrosis was associated with reduced MIO in unadjusted models; after covariate adjustment, fibrosis remained significant, except in the neck. CONCLUSION: These findings provide the first evidence linking regional and severity-based HNL/F classification with MIO and support HNL/F phenotyping in trismus assessment.

scan.title: Targeting the IGF-estrogen receptor signaling nexus in thyroid cancer: From molecular crosstalk to precision therapeutics
scan.title_zh: 靶向IGF-雌激素受体信号轴用于甲状腺癌精准治疗
scan.domain: 生物材料表面/降解产物如…

scan.one_line: 综述+实验：IGF-ERα交叉激活PI3K-AKT-mTOR与MAPK通路驱动甲状腺癌细胞增殖和分化障碍。
scan.so_what: 方法学参考价值：信号通路交叉对话（crosstalk）的实验策略（共沉淀、磷酸化检测、基因敲除）可…
scan.caution: 未标注具体体内验证深度；若以综述为主则证据价值有限。
scan.abstract: The potential convergence of insulin-like growth factor (IGF) and estrogen receptor alpha (ERα) signaling represents a compelling molecular hypothesis in thyroid cancer, linking growth factor and hormonal responsiveness to malignant progression and therapeutic resistance. IGF signaling through IGF-1 receptor (IGF-1R) and insulin receptor isoform A (IR-A) activates phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K)-AKT-mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) and mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) pathways, promoting proliferation and survival. An experimentally established IGF-2/IR-A autocrine loop further contributes to tumor-cell proliferation and impaired differentiation. Concurrently, ERα fosters proliferative and invasive phenotypes through keratin 19 (KRT19), potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily Q member 3 (KCNQ3)-associated MAPK activation, and epigenetic regulation, whereas estrogen receptor beta (ERβ) may exert context-dependent antiproliferative effects. Although reciprocal ERα-IGF-1R interactions have been demonstrated in non-thyroid models, direct molecular crosstalk in thyroid cancer remains unconfirmed. These findings provide a rationale for investigating ERα antagonism or degradation, selective ERβ activation, and IGF axis inhibition as potential therapeutic strategies. This article proposes that functional interplay between IGF and ERα signaling may create distinct oncogenic dependencies beyond the individual contributions of either pathway. Establishing such cooperation and determining whether combined inhibition offers advantages over individual targeting are essential steps toward evaluating its potential for biomarker-guided therapeutic development in thyroid cancer.

scan.title: From Symptoms to Burden: Multidomain Phenotyping of Temporomandibular Disorders in Young Adults
scan.abstract: BACKGROUND: Temporomandibular disorders (TMDs) are heterogeneous conditions with multifactorial origins. Symptom presence alone provides limited insight into patient impact; burden-based frameworks offer more patient-centred characterization. OBJECTIVES: To compare biopsychosocial characteristics of young adults with and without TMD symptoms, examine burden differences across pain-related (PT), intra-articular (IT) and combined (CT) subtypes, and evaluate associations among TMD burden, somatic symptoms, psychological distress, sleep quality and oral health-related quality of life (OHRQoL). METHODS: A cross-sectional study of 540 young adults (aged 19-24), recruited from a university via intranet and peer referrals, employed validated instruments. Group comparisons used nonparametric tests; associations were examined with Spearman's correlations and multivariable regression (α = 0.05). RESULTS: TMD symptoms were reported by 35.6% of participants, with 28.6% describing them as bothersome. Affected individuals were more often female and exhibited higher somatic burden, greater psychological distress and poorer OHRQoL (all p < 0.001). CT cases bore the highest burden, with over half reporting bothersome symptoms, consistently surpassing PT and IT across somatic, psychological and OHRQoL domains. Somatic burden correlated moderately with psychological distress (rs = 0.475). Regression analyses showed OHRQoL significantly associated with TMD burden (B = 0.36), while somatic burden was linked to psychological distress (B = 0.40), sleep quality (B = 0.08) and OHRQoL (B = 0.21). Models explained 14% and 31% of variance, respectively. CONCLUSION: Burden-based phenotyping highlights CT as the most impacted subtype and underscores the interplay of somatic, psychological and quality-of-life factors. These findings support integrated, multidomain approaches to TMD management in young adults.

scan.title: Effect of augmented reality on dental anxiety and pain perception in children: a randomized controlled clinical study
scan.title_zh: 增强现实干预儿童牙科焦虑的RCT
scan.one_line: 三臂RCT（n=96）证实AR干预降低儿童牙髓切断术后的主观焦虑及皮质醇水平。
scan.so_what: 与q1-q5均无实质关联；仅为儿童心理干预研究，无免疫/微生物组机制洞察。
scan.caution: 生理标记物（皮质醇、α-淀粉酶）虽客观，但行为结局主观性强；临床转化局限。
scan.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To evaluate the effects of an augmented reality (AR) application on children's dental anxiety using physiological, psychological, and behavioral parameters. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Ninety-six children aged 6-8 years requiring pulpotomy were randomly allocated to Control (CG), Cartoon (CaG), and AR (ARG) groups (n = 32 each). The Wong-Baker FACES (WB-FACES), Modified Child Dental Anxiety Scale [MCDAS(f)], Frankl Behavior Rating Scale (FBRS), pulse rate, and salivary cortisol, α-amylase, and chromogranin-A (CHGA) levels were assessed pre- and post-treatment. RESULTS: Post-treatment FBRS scores were higher in the ARG than the CG and CaG (p = 0.011; p = 0.041), and WB-FACES scores were lower in the ARG than the CG (p = 0.034). Baseline MCDAS(f) scores were lower in the ARG; after adjustment, post-treatment MCDAS(f) remained lower in the ARG than the CaG (p < 0.001) but not the CG (p = 0.121). Pulse rate changed only in the ARG (p = 0.001), without between-group differences. Cortisol reduction was greater in the ARG than the CG (p = 0.030) and CaG (p = 0.020), and α-amylase reduction was greater than in the CG (p = 0.001), whereas CHGA reduction was greater in the CaG than the ARG (p = 0.005). CONCLUSIONS: AR was associated with better cooperation; however, its effects on anxiety and physiological stress markers were inconsistent, and overall superiority was not demonstrated. CLINICAL RELEVANCE: To our knowledge, this study is among the first to integrate tell-show-do and positive reinforcement into an AR application and evaluate its effects on dental anxiety in children, highlighting the potential of AR as an adjunctive behavioral guidance approach in pediatric dentistry.

scan.one_line: 微生态龋损模型诱导牙本质龋洞，APC系统测得Biodentine/TheraCal LC对MDPC-23及DPSC穿透…

scan.caution: 体外APC模型，n=24；细胞活力检测未包含M1/M2极化标志物，无法支撑免疫…
scan.abstract: INTRODUCTION: To evaluate the transdentinal biological effects of lining/pulp-capping materials applied to caries-affected dentin using an artificial pulp chamber (APC) model. METHODS: Artificial caries lesions were induced in human dentin using a microcosm biofilm model. Caries-affected dentin discs (N = 24) were mounted in APCs, and MDPC-23 cells were seeded on the pulpal side. Occlusal surfaces were treated with Dycal (DY), Ultra-Blend Plus (UB), Biodentine (BD), TheraCal LC (TC), ultrapure water (negative control - NC), or hydrogen peroxide (positive control - PC). Transdentinal cytotoxicity was assessed after 24 hours using AlamarBlue and scanning electron microscopy. Transdentinal extracts were applied to MDPC-23 cells and human dental pulp stem cells (DPSCs) to evaluate cell viability and mineralized matrix formation. RESULTS: DY significantly reduced MDPC-23 viability (P < .0001), whereas UB caused a smaller reduction (P = .0279). BD and TC did not differ from the negative control (P ≥ .1344). All materials maintained MDPC-23 and DPSC viability in extract assays. TC increased mineralized nodule formation in MDPC-23 cells after 14 days (P < .0001). In DPSCs, UB and BD promoted early mineralization, whereas BD and TC enhanced mineralized matrix formation after 14 days (P < .0001). CONCLUSIONS: BD and TC showed the most favorable biological performance, preserving cell viability and enhancing mineralization through caries-affected dentin, whereas DY showed the least favorable response.

scan.title: Association between preoperative omega-3/vitamin E supplementation and tissue inflammatory and redox biomarkers in persistent apical periodontitis
scan.title_zh: 术前ω-3/VE补充对根尖周炎组织炎症影响
scan.one_line: 小样本RCT显示术前补充ω-3/VE可降低根尖病变组织炎症及氧化应激标记物。
scan.so_what: 与q1有间接关联，提示营养干预可能调节根尖周免疫微环境；但q1更关注种植体周。
scan.caution: n=8过少，效应估计不稳，不能外推至种植体周。
scan.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To evaluate whether preoperative supplementation with an omega-3/vitamin E-containing formulation was associated with differences in the tissue inflammatory and redox biomarker profile of persistent asymptomatic periapical lesions requiring endodontic microsurgery. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This prospective non-randomized controlled clinical study included adult patients with persistent asymptomatic post-treatment apical periodontitis in previously treated teeth requiring endodontic microsurgery. Participants were allocated to a control group or to a supplementation group receiving omega-3/vitamin E for 40 days before surgery. Periapical lesion tissues were collected during surgery, and laboratory analyses were performed with laboratory personnel blinded to group allocation. Tissue extracts were analysed for inflammatory cytokines, matrix-related biomarkers, and oxidative stress markers. Sixteen participants were included in the final per-protocol analysis (n = 8 per group). RESULTS: Compared with the control group, the omega-3/vitamin E group showed significantly lower tissue levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including IL-6 and TNF-α. The supplemented group also exhibited significantly lower levels of MMP-2, VEGF-A and TBARS, together with significantly higher levels of IFN-γ, IL-13 and PDGF-AB/BB. No significant differences between-group were observed for IL-1β, IL-4, IL-10, IL-17 A, MCP-1, MMP-9, or protein carbonyl levels. CONCLUSIONS: Preoperative omega-3/vitamin E supplementation was associated with a distinct molecular profile characterized by reduced inflammatory and oxidative stress markers and selective changes in immunoregulatory mediators. These findings suggest modulation of the lesional microenvironment but should be interpreted as exploratory. CLINICAL RELEVANCE: Host-modulatory strategies such as omega-3/vitamin E supplementation may influence the local biological profile of persistent apical lesions, although their clinical impact remains to be determined. TRIAL REGISTRATION: This study was registered in the Brazilian Clinical Trials Registry - ReBEC, under registration number RBR-9mjf86. ( https://ensaiosclinicos.gov.br/rg/RBR-9mjfj86 ).

scan.title: Diurnal rhythmicity in metabolism and salivary effector expression shapes aphid performance on host plants
scan.title_zh: 昼夜节律驱动的唾液效应物表达调控蚜虫寄主适应
scan.one_line: APH转录组揭示唾液效应物呈昼夜振荡，夜间高峰与取食行为同步，基因沉默验证其功能。
scan.so_what: 间接启发：口腔微生物/宿主界面存在分泌节律，可迁移至salivary microbiome与hos…
scan.caution: 蚜虫-植物系统与人类口腔免疫异质性大，不能直接外推。
scan.abstract: Diurnal rhythms influence insect behavior, physiology, and metabolism, optimizing their performance by adapting to daily changes in the environment. While their impact on agricultural pests has been briefly explored, our understanding of how these rhythms drive adaptive responses in pest biology and influence host colonization remains elusive. Here, we show that a notorious global aphid pest, Rhopalosiphum padi, exhibits distinct diurnal patterns in feeding behavior, with elevated honeydew excretion at night and extended phloem salivation during early nighttime. Temporal aphid transcriptome profiling reveals four diurnally rhythmic clusters, two of which peak at night, exhibiting enrichment in carbohydrate and amino acid metabolism. Beyond the established role in manipulating host responses and allowing sustained feeding, our study reveals novel evidence of cyclical fluctuations in salivary effector expression in an insect species. Silencing key effector genes, peaking in expression during the increased nighttime salivation, results in a more pronounced reduction in aphid excretion activity on host plants during the night compared to the day, a phenomenon not observed on artificial diets. A better understanding of aphid diurnal rhythms and their roles in shaping aphid performance provides a promising avenue to refine and optimize pest management, granting a strategic advantage for minimizing crop damage.
